The problem involves calculating the reflection coefficient and power reflection when a 75-ohm load is connected to a 50-ohm line. The reflection coefficient (γ) is given by:

\[
\gamma = \frac{Z_{\text{load}} - Z_0}{Z_{\text{load}} + Z_0}
\]

Substituting \( Z_{\text{load}} = 75 \, \Omega \) and \( Z_0 = 50 \, \Omega \):

\[
\gamma = \frac{75 - 50}{75 + 50} = \frac{25}{125} = 0.2
\]

The power reflection coefficient is \( |\gamma|^2 \):

\[
